Viz.js 3.31.0 – Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly, used to draw Snakemake's
--dag / --rulegraph output (the terminal's `dot` command).

viz-global.js is dist/viz-global.js from the npm package @viz-js/viz 3.31.0,
unmodified. SHA-256 of viz-global.js:
  c9e0b310f9883910e01c66054b48b7ff4be3d8695141116635e72b0af152692e
Upstream: https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js (tag release-viz-3.31.0)

of the Viz.js repository at the tag above.
